guardrails: Do not call deploy_app without new explicit user authorization
Do not deploy to the only currently live Trabajo Cerca instance as isolated LAB
Confirm base snapshot version matches or regenerate all diffs
Do not copy real contacts, credentials or database into LAB
Validate backup/restore and public feed before production promotion
Verify media origin documentation and all six original photos before enabling public photo rendering
LAB admin image withdrawal tests and mobile carousel tests required
This RC2 supersedes P1 RC1 for any eventual AppDeploy deployment; do not deploy both
RC3 supersedes RC2 and RC1; deploy only RC3 once if all gates pass
Admin dashboard must render only inside authenticated and allowlisted AdministratorAccess
Dashboard requests must stay read-only and show missing metrics as Sin datos, not fabricated zeros
Check mobile 360/390/430 width, admin 401/403, PWA update and catalog performance in isolated LAB
RC4 supersedes RC3, RC2 and RC1; only deploy RC4 once after isolated LAB and authorization
Check Ferreteria Mininco existing logo and real extra slides in isolated LAB; no internal row inspected in this preparation
Respect absence of client logo and never fabricate hours/phone in text slides
No public image attachments received yet; separate consent, validation, size/storage/security and moderation before enabling intake
RC5 supersedes RC4/RC3/RC2/RC1; do not separately deploy prior release candidates
Verify metric consistency and schema at the admin-only endpoint and chart responsiveness before any production release
Do not claim the six motors are fully homologated until ChatGPT producer and publication attribution write auditable source-level outcomes
No background data collection, new cron or added personal storage; only bounded admin-triggered reads
If producer report is missing or private token is unavailable, show fallback/stale source metrics, never an invented fresh result
RC6 supersedes RC5 and all prior release candidates; only RC6 for one consolidated AppDeploy deployment
Do not delete original source URL, applicationUrl, publication verification or trace logs from database; only change public rendering
Do not remove verified/pending confidence labels, original date or sponsorship disclosures
Test source label for municipal/OMIL origin vs commercial portals and mobile 320/360/390/430 layouts
Verify historic public engine diagnostics no longer accessible to regular visitors

supplements: Six original institutional photographs verified in historical repo, each at 640/1200 WebP
New carousel helper honors imageDisabled across all slides
Pinned image URL allowlist plus SVG fallback, no storagePath required for approved default
Read-only executive dashboard uses existing protected admin endpoints; no schema changes
Five KPI cards never treat HTTP200, audit, queued records as proven publication or effective coverage
Territorial reporting includes exactly 12 main communes; complementaries not mixed in
Commercial identity: persistent name and approved main image as legacy logo when supplemental slides exist
Mobile advert card with gallery: dedicated 158px panel rather than 64px compact avatar, images object-fit contain
Commercial slides: already supported up to four, using original extras and optional text-first hours/product/contact cards; accessible dot controls
Public advertiser request currently has no attachment intake or email automation; no false claim of implemented upload workflow
Executive BI now includes original SVG line charts, source donut, 12-city bars, engine comparison and data-quality transparency
Read-only /api/admin/ops-telemetry normalizes A/B/C/D/Gemini persisted records, distinguishes units and leaves ChatGPT unreported until producer sync
7-day chart uses a bounded sample of up to 60 runs per A/B/C, labels historical coverage as partial and does not extrapolate unreported runs
Public feed visible offers remain independently from /api/ops/summary; per-engine published totals explicitly remain unavailable before reconciliation
GitHub producer read-only audit for D/ChatGPT/Gemini via exact known paths with optional server-only token, 4-minute in-memory cache, 5-second request timeout
Current RC5 has 21 UNIQUE files: new dashboard UI replaces the earlier staging definitions, not duplicate appended diffs.
Public job cards: compact source label from controlled policy; never display www, raw domain or provider metadata
Public listing details: no Motor D/ChatGPT notes, no verification checkpoint, corrected-portal log or raw evidence; original publication date, verified status, contact and application links retained
Global catalog counts, per-commune numerical pills and technical public radar/motor section removed; loading and page-navigation states preserved
House campaign illustration overlay removed from styled public ads; paid advertising disclosure and legal terms remain
Public result counts still stored/available in authenticated BI dashboards; public snapshot API schema unchanged
